title: Stripe: Infrastructure as Leverage
summary: How Patrick and John Collison turned seven lines of code into the payments backbone of the internet economy.
challenge: Payments were dominated by legacy processors requiring weeks of integration and percentage-point pricing. Developer experience was an afterthought.
strategy: Developer-first API, instant onboarding, transparent pricing, and relentless platform expansion into fraud, tax, and capital.
outcome: $65 billion valuation, $1.4 trillion in payment volume annually, and deep infrastructure lock-in across 3 million businesses.
